title: Planter in Watercolor
content: I’m interested in the pattern of leaves, which are mostly light against a darker background. I paint around the leaf shapes, then color the leaves with a variety of light yellow greens and pale blue greens. The cast shadow appears bluer at its edges, and darker in the occlusion shadow near the base of the pot. I’m intrigued by the way the cast shadows stretch diagonally across the front plane of the square concrete base.
